statement: The war between Russia and Ukraine will shift further in favor of Ukraine due to their technological advantages, particularly in drone warfare.
transcript_excerpt: We're well over four years in now. It's getting far less attention on the headlines, but for the first time in well over two years, we've just had a month where the Ukrainians have taken net territory back, their own territory, from Russia.
